purpose: Run persistent multi-actor narrative games before Storyteller selects and renders prose.
architecture: world -> arc -> game -> round -> action collision -> writeback

prohibited_crossing: Storyteller may not rewrite StoryBox truth to improve drama
StoryBox may not force an outcome to satisfy a literary arc
Storyteller may hide truth from reader but may not change it
StoryBox may end in deadlock, failure or partial resolution

round_definition.start: a material trigger changes what at least one eligible actor can or must do
end: all eligible actors have acted/passed for the current trigger
hard interrupt changes the action set

successful: dominant objective absorbed into a stable institutional rule
old objective legitimately superseded by a new dominant game
game_convergence.important_rule: Convergence is not victory. A deadlock is a valid game result and may become a later-world trigger.

anti_filler.zero_delta_rule: Repeated rounds with no material truth/info/belief/power/relationship/map/resource/deadline/mystery change terminate as deadlock or equilibrium.
anti_filler.no_chat_for_chat_rule: Conversation alone is not a material delta unless it changes information, belief, commitment, relationship evidence, authority, resource or future action set.
anti_filler.no_forced_breakthrough: If actors lack evidence or legal moves, record the deadlock; do not invent discovery to keep the plot moving.

character_rules.new_actor_entry: only when the active game reaches their role, information, authority, interest, location or existing relationship

next_actions: execute Round 1 from the fixed incident trigger
compare engine state changes with existing Chapter 1-2 prose probes
revise prose only after the round state is stable
do not add more prose chapters merely to advance the manuscript
